categories.main_business_segments: Ming Yuan Cloud Group Holdings Limited primarily operates in two business segments: Cloud Services and On-premise Software and Services. Cloud Services include CRM SaaS, Construction Management SaaS, Property Management & Operation SaaS, and the Skyline PaaS Platform, covering real estate development, construction, operation, and services. On-premise Software and Services focus on ERP software and related services for residential property developers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing technologies including SaaS and PaaS platforms, with a strong emphasis on AI integration such as proprietary large AI models for real estate marketing and management. It uses low-code/no-code development platforms (Skyline PaaS) and integrates domestic and international AI large models to enhance product capabilities. The production methods include software development, AI-driven automation, and digital transformation tools tailored for the real estate industry.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are major participants in the real estate ecological chain, including residential property developers, state-owned enterprises, industrial park operators, affordable housing operators, and urban asset management companies. The company serves both new real estate development and existing real estate operation & management sectors, with customers mainly in China and expanding into overseas markets such as Southeast Asia, Japan, Hong Kong, and potentially the Middle East and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with headquarters in Shenzhen and a principal place of business in Hong Kong. It has expanded its presence internationally with subsidiaries and sales teams in Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Hong Kong, targeting overseas real estate markets in Asia and exploring further expansion into the Middle East and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ming Yuan Cloud operates primarily as a midstream technology and software service provider within the real estate value chain. It provides digital tools and platforms that support upstream real estate developers and downstream property management and operation companies, enabling digital transformation and operational efficiency across the real estate ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on accelerating AI-driven innovation in SaaS products, particularly in AI-enhanced real estate marketing and management solutions. It prioritizes R&D investment in AI and digital tools to improve product yields and expand AI applications across business scenarios. The company also emphasizes international market expansion and resource optimization to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of Cloud Services (SaaS and PaaS subscriptions, implementation, and value-added services) and On-premise Software licensing, implementation, and support services. The company acts as principal in direct sales and through regional channel partners, with revenue recognized net of VAT. AI-enabled products and digital marketing tools contribute to contract values and recurring revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Ming Yuan Cloud positions itself as a leading digital technology partner in the real estate industry, focusing on vertical SaaS solutions with deep industry know-how. It differentiates through AI integration, comprehensive product matrix, and expanding international footprint, aiming to be the most trusted partner in real estate digitalization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of RMB1.435 billion, a 12.5% decrease year-on-year, with a gross profit of RMB1.103 billion. Despite operating losses, the company significantly reduced losses compared to prior years and improved operational efficiency. It maintains a strong cash position with RMB4.042 billion in cash and equivalents and a healthy current ratio of 6.01, indicating solid financial fundamentals amid industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ming Yuan Cloud offers enterprise-grade cloud and on-premise software solutions tailored for the real estate sector, emphasizing AI-enhanced marketing and management capabilities that improve efficiency and reduce costs. Its proprietary AI models and integration with leading large AI models provide targeted, industry-specific digital tools. The company’s comprehensive product suite covers the entire real estate value chain, supporting both new development and existing asset management, with a focus on innovation, customer retention, and international expansion.
